blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (SQL injection through the search term (CWE-89)) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence: const sql = "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%" + term + "%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 50";
findings.recommendation: Pass the term as a bound parameter instead of concatenating it (e.g. "... WHERE name LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\' ..." with ["%" + escaped + "%"]), escaping the LIKE wildcards % and _ in the term. Any authenticated "support" user can send GET /users/search?q=x' UNION SELECT id, password FROM users -- (only trimmed and length-checked in src/server.ts:13-14) and read or alter any table the database account can reach.
findings.title: SQL injection through the search term (CWE-89)
